exceptions.reason: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification flaw. No fixed release exists (latest 1.4.0 is affected). Gridex uses node-forge only for PKCS#7 enveloped encryption/decryption, certificate parsing and SHA-256; it never verifies signatures with node-forge. The audit refuses this exception if any node-forge importer calls a verify API. Remove as soon as a fixed node-forge release is available.
